title.en: Fees (Attendance in Court — Ministry of Defence) Order

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 1 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Fees (Attendance in Court — Ministry of Defence) Order.

2. There shall be payable to the Ministry of Defence in respect of each half-day’s attendance in court or part thereof by any of the servicemen set out in the first column of the Schedule the fees set out opposite thereto in the second column thereof.
